passages.text: Our family decides to take a train trip to a small town where my aunt lives. Instead of spending the whole journey on screens, we each choose something to notice through the window. Mia counts bridges, while I sketch buildings as we pass by them. One unusual roof appears for only a moment, so I leave a space rather than invent its missing details. At our aunt's house, we show the notebook and explain which parts we saw clearly and which remain uncertain. The journey becomes a shared observation game, with careful notes that we can honestly explain.

parallelText.en: Our family decides to take a train trip to a small town where my aunt lives.
parallelText.zh: 我们一家决定坐火车旅行，去姨妈住的小镇。

parallelText.en: Instead of spending the whole journey on screens, we each choose something to notice through the window.
parallelText.zh: 我们没有全程看屏幕，而是各选一种窗外观察对象。

parallelText.en: Mia counts bridges, while I sketch buildings as we pass by them.
parallelText.zh: 米娅数桥，我在经过建筑时把它们画下来。

parallelText.en: One unusual roof appears for only a moment, so I leave a space rather than invent its missing details.
parallelText.zh: 一个特殊屋顶只出现片刻，我留白，没有编造没看清的细节。

parallelText.en: At our aunt's house, we show the notebook and explain which parts we saw clearly and which remain uncertain.
parallelText.zh: 到姨妈家后，我们展示笔记本，说明哪些看清、哪些还不确定。

parallelText.en: The journey becomes a shared observation game, with careful notes that we can honestly explain.
parallelText.zh: 旅程变成共同观察游戏，留下能如实说明的细致记录。

passages.text: During a weekend visit, our class can go around the craft village in small groups. Each group chooses one workshop where it can ask questions without interrupting the workers. Mia wants to watch weaving, while Ben is interested in how wooden bowls are shaped. Before leaving each place, we pack up our notebooks and check that no pencils remain on the benches. At the meeting point, we compare what different workers showed us and add labels to our sketches. Careful movement between workshops gives us varied ideas without leaving our belongings in someone else's workspace.

parallelText.en: During a weekend visit, our class can go around the craft village in small groups.
parallelText.zh: 周末参观时，我们班可以分小组在手工村四处走走。

parallelText.en: Each group chooses one workshop where it can ask questions without interrupting the workers.
parallelText.zh: 每组选一间作坊，在不打扰工人的情况下提问。

parallelText.en: Mia wants to watch weaving, while Ben is interested in how wooden bowls are shaped.
parallelText.zh: 米娅想看编织，本对木碗怎样成形感兴趣。

parallelText.en: Before leaving each place, we pack up our notebooks and check that no pencils remain on the benches.
parallelText.zh: 离开每处前，我们收好笔记本，检查长椅上没有遗漏铅笔。

parallelText.en: At the meeting point, we compare what different workers showed us and add labels to our sketches.
parallelText.zh: 到集合点，我们比较各位工人展示的内容，给速写加标签。

parallelText.en: Careful movement between workshops gives us varied ideas without leaving our belongings in someone else's workspace.
parallelText.zh: 在作坊间仔细转移，让我们获得多样想法，也不把物品留在别人的工作区。
